American League West Division Winner is Seattle Mariners
The <Seattle Mariners:team#24> stand alone as kings of the American League West Division.

With a record currently sitting at 93-59, the Mariners have wrapped up their 4th division crown.

"Bring on the playoffs," said a confident reliever <Eduard Bazardo:player#364>. "We wish it started today, we're ready to go."

Seattle will be looking to win its 1st Major League Baseball championship when the postseason gets underway.
